params.1273: Given by the Strange Old Man, at the Barrows, for completing all Hard Tasks in Morytania.
params.1292: Morytania legs 3 and a magic lamp worth 20,000XP in a skill of your choice. Robin offers 26 lots of bonemeal in exchange for bones, and 26 free buckets of slime per day.
params.1274: The legs gain the following additional benefits:
params.1275: - Increased chance of gaining better keys from burning shades.
params.1276: - 50% more Prayer XP by burning shades.
params.1277: - All ghosts will now talk to you as if you were wearing the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
params.1278: - Prayer drain in the Barrows is reduced by 50%. Receive double runes from Barrows chests.
params.1279: - 10% more Temple Trekking rewards. 50% chance that Blood Altar teletabs don't break on use.
